sources.equilibrium_definition: K = [cis]/[trans], derived from a reversible first-order concentration-time fit; fitted equilibrium constants are not automatically invalid because they use kinetic data.

native_conditions.pH_at_reaction_temperature: Different from preparation pH; the source discusses monitoring and a calculated temperature correction. Row-specific fixed-pH7 transfer is not established here.
native_conditions.I0_extrapolation: The source fits log kinetic rate versus sqrt(buffer ionic strength) and reports intercepts at zero ionic strength. These are derived values, not direct zero-salt observations. Table3.11 ionic strengths are retained as source values, not independently endorsed.
native_conditions.solute_activity_standardization: An activity-based, condition-matched298.15K,pH7 reference and uncertainty have not been constructed.

table3_5.error_description: Source footnote calls this standard error at95%confidence level. Preserve this wording; do not assume SD,1sigma or a particular confidence-interval construction.

table3_19.scope: Averages across the preceding native-temperature/buffer experiments. Not five298.15K measurements and not five independent chemical equations.
